question_text: A DPWH environmental report noted that the new highway will 'effect' a reduction in travel time. Which sentence uses 'effect' correctly?

options.text: The new highway will effect a reduction in travel time.
The new highway will affect a reduction in travel time.
The new highway will have a positive affect on travel time.
The new highway will effect a reduction in travel time, but the affect on traffic is minimal.
